column1: # Stage S11a, agent J3c — developer_tools' staging verification engines become three crates under
# tools/staging: the tokio-free plan and report module becomes staging_load_plan, the load
# generator becomes staging_load_generator (its module root becomes the `load_run` module), and
# the relay becomes acknowledgement_dropping_relay; the engines' feature document moves into the
# staging mirror. The crate roots, the generator's module tree and the emptied
# `staging_verification` module root and README are written or removed by hand. Paths name the
# staging_load_plan: the load_plan module; its module root becomes the crate root
# staging_load_generator: the load_generation module; its module root holds `run`
# acknowledgement_dropping_relay: the acknowledgement_relay module; its module root becomes the crate root
# the feature document joins the staging mirror
# the moved code names its own crate
